svg.title: 3C sprint lifecycle: state machine from backlog to retrospective
svg.desc: Diagram B. State machine showing every issue's path from backlog through plan, RED test, implement, GREEN, verify, ship to retrospective. The retrospective-to-rule feedback loop is the core learning mechanism that compounds team knowledge across sprints.
